title: Days Outside the Stay in a Reconciled Estimate Month: Skilled Admission and Discharge Elsewhere
content:
Under Medical Assistance Nursing Facility Coverage, a reconciled estimate month does not price days on which the resident was not yet, or no longer, in the center: the days before a skilled admission under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage that began inside the month, and the days after a held bed's last held day where a reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations ended because the hospital discharged the resident elsewhere.

**Rule.** Days of a reconciled estimate month outside the stay: where the resident's Medicare coverage with the latest coverage start date began inside the month on the day its qualifying hospital stay ended, a skilled admission, and the resident's bed-hold reservation that ended because the hospital discharged the resident elsewhere, the one with the latest end date, had its last held day inside the month, the days of the month before that admission and the days after that last held day are both taken out; where only that admission fell inside the month, the days of the month before it; where only that last held day fell inside the month, the days of the month after it; otherwise none.

**Input — judgement — output.**

- Input: the latest coverage start date and its qualifying hospital discharge date; the last held day of the latest reservation that ended with the hospital discharging the resident elsewhere.
- Judgement 1: the coverage start falls inside the month and is the same day the qualifying hospital stay ended — a skilled admission inside the month.
- Judgement 2: that last held day falls inside the month.
- Output: both — the days before the admission and the days after the last held day; judgement 1 only — the days before the admission; judgement 2 only — the days after the last held day; neither — none.

*Hypothetical:* a coverage starting on day 11 of a 30-day month, the same day its qualifying hospital stay ended, takes out days 1 to 10. A coverage starting on day 11 whose qualifying stay ended on day 9 is not a skilled admission for this rule and takes out nothing. A last held day on day 19 takes out days 20 to 30.
